datasets.label: Zhu 2024 darkness
datasets.scale: BLUP (best linear unbiased predictor) as published
datasets.citation: Zhu F, Ahchige MW, et al. The natural variance of Arabidopsis secondary metabolism on extended darkness. Sci Data 11:841 (2024).
datasets.note: Plants harvested at 35 d (0 d darkness) and 41 d (6 d darkness) after germination; the 0 d and 6 d sheets report different metabolite subsets. Col-0 is not in this panel.

datasets.label: Wu 2018 leaf
datasets.scale: normalised intensity as published (log2 scale; 1st-99th percentile 13.9-31.1, and the two ion modes sit on different levels)
datasets.citation: Wu S, Tohge T, et al. Mapping the Arabidopsis metabolic landscape by untargeted metabolomics at different environmental conditions. Mol Plant 11(1):118-134 (2018).
datasets.licence: Not open access (Elsevier). Per-accession values reproduced from Supplementary Table 3 for research use with citation.
datasets.note: Identified metabolites only: 117, out of 4,182 control and 3,968 stress features in Supplementary Table 3. The supplement's text calls the stress treatment the 32 °C darkness stress condition; this has not been checked against the main paper's methods.
